title: ORION: An Outcome-Driven LLM Advisor for RL-Based Multi-Domain 6G Slice Placement
abstract: arXiv:2610.41563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. This joint decision problem is NP-hard under continuous arrivals. Experiments on a parametrized family of multi-domain topologies show that no fixed planning strategy dominates across all regimes: the performance ranking reverses between topology classes, and feasible placements exist for most rejected requests but remain undiscovered. translated_title: ORION：面向基于强化学习的多域6G切片部署的结果驱动型LLM顾问
translated_abstract: 在跨管理域部署6G网络切片时，需要针对每个到达的请求做出在线决策：由哪个域承载各个虚拟网络功能、流量如何跨越域边界、以及是否接纳该切片。在连续到达的条件下，这一联合决策问题是NP难的。在参数化多域拓扑族上的实验表明，没有任何固定的规划策略能够在所有情形下占优：性能排名在不同拓扑类别之间会发生反转，而且大多数被拒绝的请求实际上存在可行的部署方案，只是尚未被发现。这些发现表明规划层是决定性能的关键杠杆。我们提出ORION，一种分层编排器，其中两个LLM智能体将服务意图转换为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划。协作式多智能体强化学习协调器负责选择跨域划分，并将该计划视为持久的软先验，而每个域的…
tldr: ORION提出一种分层编排框架，利用两个LLM智能体将服务意图转化为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划，再由协作式多智能体强化学习协调器完成跨域6G切片的联合部署决策，克服了NP难的在线决策问题，且性能优于任何固定规划策略。
en_tdlr: ORION is a hierarchical orchestrator in which two LLM agents translate service intents into structured requests and abstract placement plans, while a cooperative multi-agent RL coordinator selects the cross-domain partition, enabling effective online 6G slice placement decisions for an NP-hard problem where no fixed planning strategy dominates.
